rationale: The updated SECURITY_POLICY.md defines the reusable enforcement model, SPEC-v2.md says the live .outcomegraph/policy.yaml overrides built-in defaults when present, and the checked-in policy file shows repository-specific extensions that must be preserved to reproduce the effective boundary.
statement: Treat security policy as a two-layer contract: SECURITY_POLICY.md defines the observe-by-default fail-closed model, and .outcomegraph/policy.yaml supplies the live repository policy extensions that take effect when present.
